notes: Four distinct movable parts are supported. The two upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately; their closing actions occur rapidly in succession between t=712 and t=728, making their individual off midpoints slightly less certain.
scene_description: Handheld traversal of a compact kitchen in which the main refrigerator door, two separate hinged leaves of an upper cabinet over the cooktop, and one base-cabinet drawer are opened and later closed.
